text: Steenbarger: no. The ADVANCE trigger h1_close_above:bar_high is my wording and carries no volume test; my canon has none to give. I act on price (C2), and fill difficulty is NOT_SERVED: day_vol 0.46 is a proxy I cannot read as strength or weakness (R5). So the volume objection is answered by its own seats, oneil and minervini, not by me; I do not oppose adding 'on 1.4x time-of-day volume' to the trigger. My case: D HH/HL 2.3% above the last swing high, 0.5% under the 20-day high. Wrong if a one-day fade of 1 atr (my translation, C7) or a close below ma_20.
